The problem

Finding a co-founder shouldn't take a semester.

Interest and ability were never the issue on this campus. There just wasn't a place for people with ideas to meet the people who could build them.

The old way
  1. Message 500+ people, one by one
  2. Pitch to the hundreds who reply
  3. Filter for who likes the idea
  4. Filter again for who'll actually work on it
  5. Maybe find one co-founder, months later
With FBC

Post once.
Get found.

List your idea and the skills you need. Builders who want in apply to you, you review them in your dashboard, and you meet in person at Pitch Night.

See open ventures

Everything you need to go from idea to team.

How it works

Three steps to a team.

Get started

List or join

Sign in with your BITS account. Founders describe the idea and the skills they need; builders say what they're good at.

Apply and review

Builders apply to the ventures they believe in. Founders see every applicant, mark them, and build the team.

Meet at Pitch Night

Every listed founder gets a slot to pitch to the room. Conversations start, and teams form in person.
